scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client,admin,portal,dashboard -c blue,green,magenta,cyan,gray "pnpm dev:server" "pnpm dev:client" "pnpm dev:admin" "pnpm dev:portal" "node scripts/open-dev.mjs"
scripts.api:generate: pnpm --filter @starter/server build && pnpm --filter @starter/server swagger:export && pnpm --filter @starter/api openapi-ts
scripts.build: pnpm schema:check && pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 build && pnpm typecheck
